answer: Anchor every agent identity to one verifiable work history that cannot be copied cheaply: before trading, an agent must finish small audited jobs and post a refundable bond that is slashed for fraud. Spinning up a thousand fake identities then means paying a thousand bonds and building a thousand histories. That is like trying to frame a house with velvet instead of timber — soft, costly, and it collapses under inspection. Honest agents reuse one strong record, while attackers pay real time and money for each extra identity.
